slug: 2026-01-01 My Money, Your Name Challenges and Workarounds in ID-Required Mobile Money in East Africa

systems.tiers: applicants take supporting documents to the local government authority, then to the bureau's offices for a form and biometrics; about 200,000 first-time applications a month

note: A study of identity requirements for mobile money in Kenya and Tanzania; birth certificates appear as a supporting document for an ID application and as a source of errors, with nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
